title: A Fortune Teller Reads the Phantom Troupe's Leader and a City Burns as His Requiem

cuts.voiceover_text: A taxi rolls through neon-lit Yorknew City at night, carrying Neon Nostrade, a blue-haired runaway who slipped her mafia bodyguards. She chatters happily, with no idea her driver is Chrollo Lucilfer, leader of the Phantom Troupe.

Later, in a dim restaurant with purple tablecloths, the two talk over drinks. Neon boasts that important people always come to her, and that her hand moves on its own. Chrollo asks for a reading, so she has him write his name, birth date, and blood type. He writes Chrollo Lucilfer, and when she questions it, he answers that his friends just call him Boss.

Her written fortune speaks of a precious moon lost, mourned with a ceremony grand. Chrollo asks Neon whether she believes in an afterlife. She says no, explaining that fortunes are written to help the living, and this one is for him. A requiem doesn't help the dead, she adds, it comforts those left behind. Chrollo closes his eyes and smiles.

Walking her out, Chrollo corrects her. He believes in souls, and that is why he will fulfill his dead friend's wish. To wreak havoc, he answers, and his hand chops the back of her neck. He catches her as she falls, while the hallway guards close in around them.

That wish now sweeps the city. Obeying Chrollo's order to wreak havoc and make it a big show, the Phantom Troupe hits the auction district. Buildings burn as mafia gunmen empty their rifles into the flames, but the Troupe walks through the gunfire untouched. Shizuku calmly beats a man down with her vacuum cleaner, and red silhouettes of the fallen splash across the night.

Above the burning skyline, Chrollo stands with both arms raised like a conductor leading an orchestra. He asks his fallen friend Uvogin whether he can hear it, then dedicates the requiem to him as fires bloom across the city. It was the beginning of a stormy night, wild, fierce, drenched with blood, and somehow overwhelmingly sad.
